papers.t: Polycaprolactone-Modified Biochar Supported Nanoscale Zero-Valent Iron Coupling with Shewanella putrefaciens CN32 for 1,1,1-Trichloroethane Removal from Simulated Groundwater: Synthesis, Optimization, and Mechanism
Biochar-based composite microspheres embedded with zero-valent iron and soybean oil efficiently remove 1,1,1-trichloroethane and reshape microbial community in simulated groundwater
